# @three-ws/oracle-model

> The three.ws Oracle conviction model, running locally. Download the real bucket weights once, then score any pump.fun launch offline with no API key: probability it runs, probability it rugs, and the probability it runs and hands it straight back.

@three-ws/oracle-model is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npm install @three-ws/oracle-model`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/oracle-model/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/oracle-model/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/oracle-model/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/oracle-model/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
